The LUMO Camera System is engineered to deliver the ultimate mobile imaging solution for capturing stunning portraits, driven by its cutting-edge optical design and state-of-the-art computational capabilities.
The system comprises three core components:

LUMO achieves gold-standard optical quality across the full focal length by utilising modules with exceptional light sensitivity, complemented by its Ultra-Fast Focusing System, Multimodal Colour Sensing System and High-Precision Depth Sensing System.

"The hardware foundation of the Ultra-Sensing Computational Optical System consists of a combination of large-aperture optical modules that span the entire focal length range and deliver exceptional optical quality. By integrating the industry's first ultra-crystal blue glass alongside chip-level optical packaging, the system establishes a professional-grade imaging foundation built on superior optical design."
LUMO is equipped with the Ultra-Fast Focusing System, delivering rapid focusing speeds, exceptional close-up resolution and extremely short focusing distances.

"LUMO has developed the industry's first True Colour Camera, which precisely senses localised colour temperature variations to effectively address colour reproduction challenges in complex lighting conditions."
By combining pixel-level depth capture combined with large-scale AI atlas training, this system achieves high-precision depth sensing for detailed subject space computation.

LUMO integrates four advanced imaging engines – the True Colour Engine, Computational Optical Bokeh Engine, HyperTone Image Engine and Lightning Snap Engine – to deliver ultra-perceptive digital imaging quality.

The True Colour Engine, equipped with the innovative True Colour Camera, combines hardware-based colour temperature sensing with multi-modal collaborative computation to faithfully reproduce skin tones and environmental colours across diverse lighting conditions.

The Computational Optical Bokeh Engine delivers an exquisite optical bokeh effect by employing refined subject space computation, progressive spatial reconstruction rendering and 3D lens flare restoration.

MariSilicon® X uses powerful AI noise reduction and dynamic processing to eliminate noise in dark areas and retain details in bright areas at 4K resolution, delivering unprecedented clarity to each frame of your video.

When AI Highlight Video is turned on, MariSilicon® X enhances the performance of the sensor to help you capture videos with greater dynamic range at up to 4K resolution. This lets you vividly capture subjects in unfavourable lighting conditions, such as backlit human subjects or high-contrast nature scenes.

In addition to the pre-installed Camera app, MariSilicon® X extends its powerful image processing power to a variety of other camera apps so you can enjoy the same enhanced noise reduction and dynamic image processing in the camera apps you love.
